Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "could you book me a one hour beginner guitar lesson next thursday at 4:30 in room A127 no sorry B15 please list Idris as the other person coming with me since we are both bringing our own guitars and want to practice the same two chord changes the teacher can use the first ten minutes to check our tuning then spend most of the lesson on switching between G and D we have both borrowed acoustic guitars from the community music cupboard and Idris has only had his for three days so please ask for someone who is comfortable teaching complete beginners I can arrive about fifteen minutes early to fill in the registration card but Idris will come straight from his shift and might be right on time could you make sure the room has two chairs and two music stands and tell us whether we should bring a printed copy of the beginner song sheet I saw on the noticeboard I do not know if that sheet is needed for the lesson please send the booking details to my email rather than calling because I am in the library most afternoons and may not hear my phone I need to leave by 5:45 to catch the 6:05 bus from Oak Street so please keep the lesson to one hour and let me know if the teacher usually runs late", "output": "Could you book me a one-hour beginner guitar lesson next Thursday at 4:30 in room B15? Please list Idris as the other person coming with me, since we are both bringing our own guitars and want to practice the same two chord changes. The teacher can use the first ten minutes to check our tuning, then spend most of the lesson on switching between G and D. We have both borrowed acoustic guitars from the community music cupboard, and Idris has only had his for three days, so please ask for someone who is comfortable teaching complete beginners. I can arrive about fifteen minutes early to fill in the registration card, but Idris will come straight from his shift and might be right on time. Could you make sure the room has two chairs and two music stands, and tell us whether we should bring a printed copy of the beginner song sheet I saw on the noticeboard? I do not know if that sheet is needed for the lesson. Please send the booking details to my email rather than calling, because I am in the library most afternoons and may not hear my phone. I need to leave by 5:45 to catch the 6:05 bus from Oak Street, so please keep the lesson to one hour and let me know if the teacher usually runs late."}]
